approach: Static recompilation of the disc's own code on the player's PC; bring your own disc, no game files distributed.
notes: Plays the intro, the title (hold A and B), the main menu and the Museum. About 60 fps on both machines. All 115 minigame modules are translated; the game's process system runs on host coroutines. Tested on Windows 11 (RTX 3070 Ti) and on a Linux mini PC (Ryzen 3 4350GE, Vega 6) with scripted inputs; nothing here says the game is playable to the end. Built with AI assistance (Claude).
